name: terminal-simulator
title: Terminal Simulator
description: Terminal window with chunked command playback, freeze-frame pauses, step scrolling, and an optional cursor-pinned zoom camera.
docs: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/screens/terminal-simulator?ref=cli — pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette and a bare Remotion render is black.
